title: A UUID or opaque object id can be read by another account
summary: An object named by a UUID or opaque id that belongs to the second account can be read by the first account.  Guessing the id is hard, but access must still be checked.  Needs a second account configured for the site.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and status_of(b)==200 and same(response, b) and differ(response, anon)

reproduce: Sign in as account A and open an object URL (with account B's UUID) that belongs to account B.  If A sees B's object, object access is broken.
remediate: Check ownership on the server for every object, not just that the id is hard to guess.
